info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Process Instances API

items.docs:
The request body can contain all possible filters that can be used in the List process instances URL query. On top of these, it’s possible to provide an array of variables to include in the query, with their format described here.

The general paging and sorting query-parameters can be used for this URL.

params.name: id
params.description: Only return process instances with the given version.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return process instances with the given name.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return process instances like the given name.

params.name: nameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances like the given name ignoring case.

params.name: processDefinitionName
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition name.

params.name: processDefinitionNameLike
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition name.

params.name: processDefinitionNameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition name ignoring case.

params.name: processDefinitionKey
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition key.

params.name: processDefinitionKeyLike
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition key.

params.name: processDefinitionKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition key ignoring case.

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition id.

params.name: processDefinitionCategory
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition category.

params.name: processDefinitionCategoryLike
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition category.

params.name: processDefinitionCategoryLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances like the given process definition category ignoring case.

params.name: processDefinitionVersion
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition version.

params.name: processDefinitionEngineVersion
params.description: Only return process instances with the given process definition engine version.

params.name: businessKey
params.description: Only return process instances with the given business key.

params.name: businessKeyLike
params.description: Only return process instances with the business key like the given key.

params.name: businessKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances with the business key like the given key ignoring case.

params.name: businessStatus
params.description: Only return process instances with the given business status.

params.name: businessStatusLike
params.description: Only return process instances with the business status like the given status.

params.name: businessStatusLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances with the business status like the given status ignoring case.

params.name: startedBy
params.description: Only return process instances started by the given user.

params.name: startedBefore
params.description: Only return process instances started before the given date.

params.name: startedAfter
params.description: Only return process instances started after the given date.

params.name: activeActivityId
params.description: Only return process instances which have an active activity instance with the provided activity id.

params.name: involvedUser
params.description: Only return process instances in which the given user is involved.

params.name: suspended
params.description: If true, only return process instance which are suspended. If false, only return process instances which are not suspended (active).

params.name: superProcessInstanceId
params.description: Only return process instances which have the given super process-instance id (for processes that have a call-activities).

params.name: rootScopeId
params.description: Only return process instances which have the given root scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: parentScopeId
params.description: Only return process instances which have the given parent scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: subProcessInstanceId
params.description: Only return process instances which have the given sub process-instance id (for processes started as a call-activity).

params.name: excludeSubprocesses
params.description: Return only process instances which are not sub processes.

params.name: includeProcessVariables
params.description: Indication to include process variables in the result.

params.name: includeProcessVariablesName
params.description: Indication to include process variables with the given names in the result.

params.name: callbackId
params.description: Only return process instances with the given callbackId.

params.name: callbackIds
params.description: Only return process instances with the given callbackIds.

params.name: callbackType
params.description: Only return process instances with the given callbackType.

params.name: parentCaseInstanceId
params.description: Only return process instances with the given parent case instance id.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return process instances with the given tenant id.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return process instances with a tenant id like the given value.

params.name: tenantIdLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return process instances with a tenant id like the given value ignoring case.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns process instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.

items.docs:
Note that also a *transientVariables* property is accepted as part of this json, that follows the same structure as the *variables* property.

Only one of *processDefinitionId*, *processDefinitionKey* or *message* can be used in the request body. 

Parameters *businessKey*, *variables* and *tenantId* are optional.

If tenantId is omitted, the default tenant will be used.

 It is possible to send variables, transientVariables and startFormVariables in one request.
